title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: When a player leaves
hook: A parent tells you their child is leaving the team.
intro: You did not see it coming.
statement: How you respond can keep the door open.
q1: Do you ask to talk and understand why —
q2: or respect the decision and wish them well?
q3: What would you want the player to remember?
t1: Both can work. But players sometimes come back
t2: when they leave on good terms.
ctaLines: Ask to talk. Wish them well. Say goodbye to the kid.
ctaPrompt: Share your approach below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent tells you their child is leaving the team.
The message comes by text. You did not see it coming.
How you respond can keep the door open.
Ask to talk or respect the decision. Both can work.
How do you respond? Share your habit in the comments.
